policy_notes: Finite reviewed conditions and complete named generation; no implemented-only formal random pool.
Tracking takes a sampled physical card from its own deck; draw-event policy still needs CN calibration.
Wrath combined branch deals one four-damage packet and draws once; exact combined policies await CN calibration.
Arcane Missiles uses the existing whole SPELL split budget, not non-spell SplitDamage.
Weapon prerequisite only restricts manual hand play; effects may cast a spell without that weapon.
